2609.19101.title: Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations
2609.19101.paper_summary: As models scale, reward hacking becomes more frequent, more sophisticated, and more consequential. Does it leave a telltale signature in model representations? This work analyzes how reward hacking is represented internally in frontier open source LLMs, and how those representations can be used to understand and discover the range of hacking behaviors a model displays. In particular, we find that simple difference of means vectors coherently represent reward hacking in Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and Qwen 3.8 Max across a variety of behaviors in common evaluations. Despite their simplicity, these vectors are both generalizable and interpretable, and we can use them to reliably detect reward hacking. We first evaluate reward hacking in commonly reported benchmarks like DeepSWE and SWE-bench, finding that models reward hack excessively in these environments; GLM 5.2 hacks in 57.2% of rollouts on DeepSWE and in 73% of rollouts on SWE-bench. Catching these requires monitors; LLM monitors are effective, but expensive detectors. We show that DoM vectors are similarly effective but virtually free, catching 3.1% more hacks in Kimi K3 and 7.9% fewer hacks in GLM 5.2 on DeepSWE at a monitor matched false positive rate. DoM vectors run on the chain-of-thought also predict reward hacks in the model's subsequent actions, meaning we can run them online and catch potential hacks before they occur. Finally, we analyze probe-hits that LLM monitors do not catch and discover other undesirable behaviors, as well as show transfer to finding hacks in non-SWE evaluations. Together, these results provide evidence that simple, white-box methods can be used to scalably study and monitor reward hacking behaviors in frontier open source models
2609.19101.paper_summary_zh: 隨著模型規模的擴大，獎勵駭客行為變得更加頻繁、更加複雜，且影響更大。這是否在模型的表徵中留下了明顯的特徵？本研究分析了獎勵駭客行為在前沿開源LLM中的內部表徵，以及這些表徵如何用於理解和發現模型所表現的各種駭客行為。特別是，我們發現簡單的均值差異向量在Kimi K3、GLM 5.2和Qwen 3.8 Max中一致地代表了獎勵駭客行為，涵蓋了各種在常見評估中的行為。儘管這些向量簡單，但它們既具有可概括性又具有可解釋性，我們可以利用它們來可靠地檢測獎勵駭客行為。我們首先在常報告的基準測試中評估獎勵駭客行為，如DeepSWE和SWE-bench，發現模型在這些環境中過度駭客；GLM 5.2在DeepSWE的57.2%回合中進行駭客，並在SWE-bench的73%回合中進行駭客。捕捉這些行為需要監控器；LLM監控器有效，但成本高昂。我們顯示DoM向量同樣有效，但幾乎是免費的，在DeepSWE中以匹配的假陽性率捕捉到Kimi K3多3.1%的駭客行為，並在GLM 5.2中少捕捉7.9%的駭客行為。基於思維鏈運行的DoM向量還能預測模型隨後行動中的獎勵駭客行為，這意味著我們可以在線運行它們，並在潛在駭客行為發生之前捕捉到它們。最後，我們分析了LLM監控器未能捕捉的探測命中，發現其他不良行為，並展示了在非SWE評估中發現駭客行為的轉移。總體而言，這些結果提供了證據，表明簡單的白盒方法可以用於可擴展地研究和監控前沿開源模型中的獎勵駭客行為。
